message: `foreign` is no longer part of Axiom
label: `foreign` was removed because it never worked: it emitted a call to a symbol the module never declared, so a program using one passed `check` and died in `opt`. The FFI is the `extern` block
help: write an `extern` block instead - `(extern "lib" (name :: (-> Int Int) (symbol "sym")))` - and build with `--link-lib`/`--link-search`; or reach the kernel through the standard library's `__syscall0`-`__syscall6`, which needs no FFI
